# Testing & Continued Success

Course 5 of the Ads Clinic classroom (Nick Boddington). Course page: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/b581393a

> This module teaches you how to test the right way - from isolating variables to knowing how to read results, spot winning ads, and scale safely - with strategies for budget increases, creative testing, and performance benchmarks.

**Source note:** lesson text as published in Skool, plus video transcripts cleaned from the English closed captions of Skool-hosted lesson videos (auto-generated captions: filler words and stutters removed, otherwise verbatim, so expect occasional mis-heard words). Lessons whose video is a YouTube link have no transcript. Images in lessons are omitted.

## Why most ads fail

Section: Why Testing Matters  
Source: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/b581393a?md=b3d694c95f5a44c0998545adfa4e29a6

*Video: lesson video hosted in Skool.*

#### Lesson text

Let’s be real... most ads *don’t* work.

In this video, we unpack the common reasons why: weak hooks, wrong audience, poor creative, or the wrong offer. Knowing what kills performance is the first step to fixing it.

## One variable at a time

Section: Simple Testing Framework  
Source: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/b581393a?md=b3fb5c9d232740c6b26429d0f1ffdab3

*Video: lesson video hosted in Skool.*

#### Lesson text

Want to know *what’s really working*? 

Stick to one change at a time. In this video, learn why single-variable testing is the key to smart optimisation — and how to structure your tests for clear, actionable results.

## How to find out your winning ad copy

Section: Step 1: Reading Your Results  
Source: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/b581393a?md=1858d306482741d1a2564a243d740ad6

*Video: lesson video hosted in Skool.*

#### Lesson text

One of the quickest ways to figure out what’s driving results in your ad is to break down your data properly inside Ads Manager (if Meta hasnt removed your function).

Here’s how:

1. Go to Ads Manager → Find the campaign/ad set/ad you want to analyse.
2. Select Breakdown (top right dropdown).
3. Choose “By Dynamic Creative Asset” → “Text” or “Headline”.
4. You’ll now see a performance split by each headline and primary text variation.
5. Look at key metrics like CTR, CPC, and Conversions — not just impressions.

👉 The one with the highest ROI, CTR and best cost per result is your winner.

⚡ Remember: small text tweaks can create big differences in performance.

And within here, there's lots of different options that you can do. Now, Meta is phasing this out for the dynamic creative elements, so your images , videos, text, headlines, that sort of thing. However, some ad accounts still have this, it'll just be potluck if you still got that option. So once you're in here, you want to head down to dynamic creative and press text. So head to your testing campaign at level, find one of your winning ads and select that and head to preview. When you're in here go to the preview settings and scroll down to Facebook post with ads. So if you had another ad that you wanted to add into your master ad set head back to your testing campaign and find your other winning ad in the test.
